name: Hail
summary:
Hail VR is an immersive storm chasing game where you track powerful thunderstorms and tornadoes across the map. Deploy scientific probes directly in the path of storms to collect valuable weather data and earn money. The more dangerous and accurate your intercepts, the bigger the rewards.
